title: Mom Visit

source.rights_note: Publicly accessible screenplay; retain analysis and metadata only until reuse rights are confirmed.

story.logline: A couple hastily transforms their apartment and identities before an intimidating mother's visit, only to face her escalating expectations.
story.theme: family pressure, cultural expectation and relationship performance
story.character_goal: Andrea and Mike want to survive Nancy's visit without exposing their unprepared home and lifestyle.
story.obstacle: Nancy's intrusive inspection, household standards and expectations about grandchildren.
story.turning_choice: Andrea recruits Mike into a frantic preparation routine and asks him to perform a different identity.
story.result: The visit exposes deeper relationship and family pressure; the script's comic engine is escalation rather than a product resolution.

beats.visible_action: Andrea receives a message announcing her mother's arrival.
beats.evidence: the text message immediately changes the couple's behavior

beats.visible_action: Andrea orders Mike to clean, empty the refrigerator and use the name Miguel.
Nancy arrives with food and cleaning supplies and inspects the apartment.
beats.state_in: the couple believes they are ready
beats.state_out: Nancy controls the space and reveals new standards
beats.evidence: she enters without waiting and immediately evaluates the home

beats.visible_action: Nancy raises the issue of grandchildren and challenges Andrea's career priority.
beats.evidence: the conflict shifts from cleaning to life choices

scene_functions: escalate from domestic detail to emotional conflict
rules_observed: A small practical objective can carry a short comedy when each success creates a larger expectation.
anti_patterns: Cultural details should serve character and conflict, not become the only joke.
quality_notes: Clear short-form premise and escalating obstacle; useful model for visible preparation beats.
